mentions.name: Minecraft Player Stats Website Mod
mentions.description: A Minecraft mod that outputs players' stats onto a website, built on APIs so that an app or CLI tool can be created on top later. Planned improvements include better code quality, inventory and ender chest display, and achievements (possibly custom ones earnable and viewable by vanilla clients). A running demo is hosted at https://grisu-ftp.de.
mentions.source_excerpt: A Minecraft Mod that outputs the Stats of the players onto a website (I made it use APIs, so an app or CLI tool would be easy to create later on).
